arStrings.szText: {icon:bullet,1.2} When you Cast a {c_important}Marksman Basic{/c} Skill, you gain a stack of Vengeance, which grants {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%+|]{/c} increased Movement Speed and {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|%x|]{/c} increased damage for your {c_important}Marksman{/c} Skills. Vengeance stacks up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"]{/c} times and loses {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 4"]{/c} stack every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} seconds.
